output.summary: Hartwell's AHT fall is partly real (Fast Path and PolicyFind rolled out network-wide, though other sites' AHT stayed flat, so the bonus likely drives much of the drop), but AHT is gamed. Transfers rose from 11% to 20%, agent releases rose and cluster at 6-7.5 minutes, and 7-day repeats rose 41%. Tier-2 waits and overtime are up, complaints have tripled, and total minutes per issue barely fell. CSAT is blind to transferred and released calls, so it is flat by construction. The hailstorm doesn't explain the repeats, which rose on non-claims queues too. The evidence on attrition is confounded by the outsourcer, and the pay rise is premature. Halt the rollout, gate the incentive, widen survey eligibility, and keep the release alerts on.
